fields.Name: T204 - System Diagnostics Engine Detail Panel Drilldown
fields.Description: Exercises the openEngineDetailPanel drill-down (slide-in overlay + config-item accordion with sample-data paging) — a distinct rich detail UI, not the card grid itself.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the Admin application, open 'Monitoring', and select System Diagnostics (Engine Registry section). On a loaded engine card, click the details arrow button (the right-arrow icon in the card's action area) to open the engine detail slide-in panel. Confirm the panel opens showing the engine's summary (Status / Memory / Items) and a 'Data Configs' list of its cached properties. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the detail panel slide in with the engine summary and Data Configs section is success — you do NOT need to expand every config item.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking the details/arrow button on an engine card opens a slide-in detail panel for that engine
The panel shows a summary block with Status, Memory, and Items, plus a 'Data Configs' section (with config items or a 'No config items found' empty-state)
The panel can be closed via its close (X) button, returning to the engine grid
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
